questions.question: (1)Partition coefficient of a solute in two immiscible solvents is INDEPENDENT of?
(2)Which type of solute would be expected to have a higher partition coefficient between water and an organic solvent?
(3)What is the unit of partition coefficient?
(4)What is the essential condition for a solute partitioned in two solvents to follow the Nernst distributon law?

answers.b: The solute should completely dissolve in each solvent
answers.c: The solute should not associate in either solvent.

questions.question: (5)What is the condition for which the partition function is equal to its distribution function for a solute in the two solvents?

answers.a: The solute exists is in the same form in both solvents
answers.b: The two solvents have the same molecular weight
answers.c: The two solvents have the same density
answers.d: The solute does not have polar groups
